rev.summary:
I went through all 36 flagged items and all 42 corrections in design_audit_corrections.json and recorded each one in step2/qa/design_revision_disposition.json (item, refuter, verdict, action, evidence). Flagged items: 33 accepted, 3 partly, 0 rejected. I rechecked each item myself: by computation where possible, and literature claims against the local copies in step2/literature/ip_sources, the PDFs rendered where needed. Four papers were not on disk and I fetched them from arXiv: CLW 2310.20086, GKW 2403.13049, BGWW 2509.16737, CDSW hep-th/0211170.

I revised step2/theory/odd_components_design.tex and removed the AUDIT NOTICE block. It keeps the FORMAT.md markup and the existing labels, and adds new ones. It compiles with the project wrapper in step2/theory/_build_odd/ to a 21-page PDF with 0 errors and 0 undefined references. I also revised engine_plan.json, q1_targets.tex and build_q1_targets.py, regenerated q1_targets.json (now 12 targets) and recompiled the targets PDF with 0 errors.

Main changes, by item letter of the task:
- (a) Def def:o-twisted is now the full sum over k. A separate prop:o-trunc proves k ≤ 2 for every target, and lem:o-actiontrunc shows the action side has no arity ≥ 3 along Σ. Thm thm:o-twist now carries explicit hypotheses (H1)–(H4); the transport to the holomorphic letters (old item (iv)) is now a labelled identification, rem:o-transport.
- (b) The outer derivation B is in: def:o-B, lem:o-Bouter, prop:o-GB, item (e) of prop:o-laws, and the freedom tables. G_B shifts Q_1 and S_1 by opposite multiples of the classical transformations and leaves D_1, K_1, P_1, M_1, R_1 unchanged; two-component form included.
- (c) F1 is now conjugation by the R-rotation α of ESW Def 2.18 (rem:o-alpha and targets F1). The coupling direction is corrected to −aQ_0 − a[N_R, Q_0], and its arity-zero effect −a(Q+{I,−}) is stated.
- (d) c_K is a scheme-dependent pair value (prop:o-konishi, thm:o-invariants (iii)).
- (e) thm:o-ir is rewritten: (ii) has a log T term whose coefficient is 3/(8π²) times an O(ε) cut tree; (iv) now includes the P-edge η–η chains. The Decision paragraph is withdrawn. The large-distance section is rebuilt on the transfer endpoint:
  - def:o-scale and lem:o-Tflow cover finite-T objects, the UV-boundary formula at scale T, and T-independent counterterms.
  - prop:o-Tindep proves that if a local representative exists at one finite T, the same one holds at every T.
  - def:o-K defines K_1 by the K-route graphs at finite T.
  - prop:o-Kclaim is the clearly marked placeholder (existence and T-independence) for the other agent.
  - prop:o-Kconsistent lists the cross-checks: the arity-two identity at (η1,η2), and K = P^† as the fallback.
  - prop:o-Tsafe says where T → ∞ is safe: Q_1, twisted Q_1, S_1 and D_1 are computed at T = ∞. Along Δ at finite T there is an extra endpoint term −4T L_T.
- (f) Novelty table corrected: Zwiebel 1111.0083 (2.33)–(2.34), BMV's main result, BGWW §4.3, and a new target T12 (CLW rank-(1,1) supercharge) with engine item E12.
- (g) Engine guidance is now a rule (rem:o-exact and engine_plan constraints.reduction_rule): reduce outputs only by full s-exact cochains with their arity partners.
- (h) All other flagged items are dispositioned in step2/qa/design_revision_disposition.json.

Two new scripts back the new claims: outer_derivation_check.py and truncation_and_orientation_check.py. Pre-revision copies are in step2/qa/design_revision/backup.
key_results: B is an even, outer derivation of psl(4|4). Checked in the exact Chapter 2 realisation: the four chirality blocks have dimension 8, brackets inside each B-eigenspace vanish, and P, K, Δ, so(V), so(W) preserve the eigenspaces. G_B is s-closed and not in C(S−S^(2)) + Im s. Proof: averaging over Spin(4)×SU(4) reduces φ^(0) to the five field rescalings, and the four linear terms of S^(1)(ξ) give rescaling weights whose cyclic sum is 0.

Effect of G_B: Q_1 shifts by −aδ_ξ on S_+⊗W and +aδ_ξ̄ on S_−⊗W*; S_1 shifts by +aδ_η on S_+⊗W* and −aδ_η̄ on S_−⊗W; D_1, K_1, P_1, M_1, R_1 and L_1^(0) are unchanged; twisted Q_1^ξ shifts by +a[N_R, Q_0^ξ]. Identity: [N_R, Q_0^ξ] = {−S^(1)(ξ) + S^(2)(ξ,ξ), −} = [N_gh, Q_0^ξ] − Q_0^ξ.

Truncation: the smallest Weyl weight at degree −n is m(n) = 2n for n even and 2n + 1/2 for n odd. The action side has no arity ≥ 3 along Σ. For the targets, k ≥ 3 is excluded by weight, colour or W-index count. The audit's example 'k=4 at w_O=4 with (c*, λ)' is wrong: that output has degree −2, so it is k = 3.

Orientation sum for P-edge pairs: the audit's (ξ,η) control was vacuous (it subtracted an expression from itself). Recomputed: the two orientations are pointwise equal, so the total cancels and (ξ,η) pairs converge, while η–η pairs carry a log proportional to v1 = Γ(η1,η2)|_V.

Finite-T framework: counterterms are independent of T; a local representative that exists at one finite T is the same at every T (proved, given the master equation). T → ∞ is safe for every component except arity one along K, arity two along (η1,η2) with v1 ≠ 0, and arity two along (K,P); those are defined at finite T.

c_K stays scheme dependent even after the orthogonality normalisation. From EJSS (99)–(106), redefining B by y g²(F − 4B) shifts the F coefficient g²N/(32π²) by −y g². The audit's own fix 'invariant after orthogonality' is therefore rejected.

Literature corrections: the actual KvLM (5.5) index structure, read from the rendered PDF, is f^a_{cd} f^{bc}_e; neither refuter had it right. BGKWWY (C.4) = 2×BK (3.35) and (C.3) = 2×(3.36) at f = ε, recomputed. Zwiebel's 2→1 corrections are one loop and K_{3→1} is two loops. CLW Q_HT is added as target T12.
open_issues: Placeholder prop:o-Kclaim is not established: at fixed finite T, the ε→0 limit of the K-route graphs (and of the arity-two graphs along (η1,η2) and (K,P)) must exist and be local. prop:o-Tindep already proves T-independence once the representative exists at one finite T, assuming the master equation holds; the other agent should check that reduction too.

Not shown: whether the O(ε) cut tree of thm:o-ir (ii) is nonzero, and whether the tree Y of thm:o-ir (iii) and its arity-two P-edge analogue vanish (engine items E10a, E10b). These decide whether O[T]^(1)(K) and W^(1)(K) have a T → ∞ limit.
Hypothesis (H1) of thm:o-twist is open: the décalage signs for the products in W(P,J) and for the C^•-linear extension of L_1 must be fixed in code (E0) before −1/2 is quoted for L_1^(2)(ξ,ξ).
Hypothesis (H4) and the E3b rank check are open: whether every s-closed degree-0, weight-4 local cochain lies in C(S−S^(2)) + C G_B + Im s.
The transport Φ from the ESW Thm 10.9 collections to BK's letters (rem:o-transport), and the normalisation map to BK (targets open item 1), are still needed before any numerical comparison of c_K.
rem:o-GBdagger is an expectation for the conjugation/inner-product workflow, not checked here: Q^† = S should fix Re a of the G_B freedom. Those files were not edited.
Gauge-fixing law (c) of prop:o-laws remains a proof plan.

Literature statements not re-verified in this revision are listed explicitly in q1_targets open items (BGKWWY (3.24)–(3.45), (C.1)–(C.2), (C.5)–(C.9), (D.13)–(D.15); GKW (2.27), (2.31); W18 Thm 3.4; BGKWY22 (B.6); BGWW (3.46)–(3.52), (4.82)–(4.85); ESW Prop 2.21, Rem 1.29, §10.3; BK App. B; B03 Table 2). Zwiebel's thesis was not read.
